trail.text: Flagged latencies cluster around travel services — digging in to trace the fault.
Several travel services show elevated latency — checking which one spiked first to separate cause from victims.
The latency jumps look simultaneous — now hunting the underlying dependency.
Leaf services look slow while their databases look fine — checking the underlying hosts and timing.
Seat is the earliest to degrade — one final check for hidden resource faults before ranking the causes.

causes.reasoning: Leaf service with 100x latency jump (0.025 to 2.4s) on all percentiles while its mongo (c15) and CPU are flat, and its callers (travel/admin-travel) degrade after it, marking it as origin not victim.
Other leaf with earliest threshold crossing (7s) and median degradation (0.07 to 0.33s) with no resource explanation, either co-root or victim of train if seat calls train, still core fault.
Huge caller latency (0.49 to 15s) starting at 13s after leaves, with CPU down, consistent with blocking on slow train/seat downstream.
Caller latency (0.26 to 5.2s) starting at 13s with flat DB (c31) and reduced requests, victim of train/seat fan-out.
Caller latency (0.23 to 2.67s) with flat DB (c35) and later median onset (28s), victim propagating leaf slowness to preserve/UI.
